campaign_spec.critical_open_problem: Does the distinction-preserving comparison operator | generate measurable distinctions D and produce deviated admissibility δα without collapsing the operands A and B?

hypothesis.statement: |-enabled comparisons generate measurable D and D produces deviated admissibility δα.

test_design.description: Evaluate distinction generation under four structural controls ranging from no comparison to collapsed, randomized, and valid distinction-preserving comparison.

tests.name: No Bar Baseline
tests.description: A and B present but not compared

vectors.name: Identity Collapse Check
vectors.attack: Check if C1_collapse_bar generates non-trivial constraint deviation.
vectors.failure_condition: Constraint deviation in C1 is comparable to C3.
vectors.implication: Distinction preservation is not required for constraint deviation.

vectors.name: Randomized Persistence Check
vectors.attack: Check if C2_random_bar results in structured organization.
vectors.failure_condition: Organization score in C2 is comparable to C3.
vectors.implication: Distinction-preservation order is not required for persistence.

maximum_supported_claim.statement: The bar operator | allows comparison without collapse, facilitating distinction-generation and subsequent admissibility-deviation in local analog model systems.
